biography:
Prescription eyewear and sunglasses starting at $95. 
For every pair sold, a pair is distributed to someone in need.

posts.caption: Our co-founder @neilblumenthal is inside the secret room today—tune in on Snapchat (username: warbyparker) as he answers your questions!
Today on Snapchat: we try on our favorite Crystal frames in 15 seconds (username: warbyparker)!

We're thrilled to be a part of tonight's performance of @popupmagazine! If you're attending the sold-out show, make sure to check out our very own crossword puzzle (created by New York Times puzzle-maker, @davidkwong) inside the program.
Catching rays with our new ping pong paddle hand mirrors.
Our buddy @archer_pup is just hanging out at #121greene! #warbybarker
The @warbybarker festivities have begun! Tune in on Periscope for a dog's eye view of the happenings at #121greene.
One of our favorite photos (and visitors) from last year's @warbybarker event at #121greene. Will we see you at one of our stores tomorrow? All details via the link in our bio. #tbt

Are you joining us for the @warbybarker festivities on Friday? We’ve teamed up with @barkbox for a giveaway—we’re giving away one box in each store to the first person to arrive and ask about them! 20 additional people will receive a box of treats. More info via the link in our bio.
Today on Snapchat: we have a special guest inside the secret room who's very excited about our upcoming @warbybarker events!

Leo knows which frame he's wearing (Buckley in Jet Black) to our @warbybarker event this Friday! Join us to celebrate our canine friends in our retail stores—details via the link in our bio. (Photo by @dareochu.)
Once upon a time, we were told that a #warbybox makes an excellent peach transporter. Yesterday on Snapchat we tested it out (username: warbyparker).

Exciting news—this April 1 we're hosting @warbybarker events in our stores! Join us to celebrate our canine friends—they can sit for a portrait (glasses or no glasses), feast on snacks, and make new pals. Human companions can do all of these things too. All info via the link in our bio.
It's feeling like spring in New Orleans—we're keeping Milton in Aloe Green in hand! #smileneworleans
Happy first day of spring!
Earlier this week we took a trip to The #MetBreuer—excited for its grand opening today!
Spring and all the appearance of lush greenery couldn't come soon enough. That's what our designers had in mind when designing Milton in Aloe Green (here just in time for St. Patrick's Day, too).
Perfect day to pull up a step for lunch.
Happy Pi Day! (The green one is matcha and it's pretty tasty.) #teamwarby
Interconnected clocks at @cooperhewitt by @humanssince1982 make time change look good—meanwhile, we need a nap. #daylightsavings
Just a week (and a few days) 'til spring!
Meet oval Ingles in a sprightly new hue, Redbird. Shop the full Windsor Spring Collection via the link in our bio.
Our new Windsor Spring Collection takes its cues from the levity and energy of the circus along with freshness of the new season. Shop now via the link in our bio.

Good news: We’ve brought back the one-of-a-kind Windsor rim construction that we introduced in December! Even better? These limited-edition frames come in striking new shapes and hues. Shop the Windsor Spring Collection via the link in our bio.
These luminous Lemon sunglasses guarantee a memorable first impression. Shop Downing 16 in Lemon via the link in our bio.
This handsome guy, Lou Taylor, recently stopped by the Frame Studio in New Orleans—and he's just a puppy! #smileneworleans
Today on Snapchat: our Head of Copy, Molly, demonstrates various advanced reading positions for you to try out when enjoying your next read. Now, get reading! (Username: warbyparker.)
Let's just say we've taken a lot of photos of the floor at @oxfordexchange. Have you visited our new showroom there yet?
We're celebrating Leap Day with a long leap competition in our office—see more #teamwarby hops over on Snapchat! (Username: warbyparker.)

We’re back with a new way to use that nice grey box that your frames come in! Today on Snapchat we’re showing you how to turn your #warbybox into a piggy bank (username: warbyparker). Do you have an out of the box idea? Show us how you use your #warbybox and we may give your idea a try in our next Snapchat story!
Last week our friend @AmandadeCadenet launched the #girlgaze project, highlighting female photographers and aiming to illustrate how girls see the world. We’re looking forward to more to come!

Join us tonight in our retail stores from 6:30-8:30pm to celebrate #apopofspring! We’ll have plenty of snacks (popcorn! cotton candy!) and a trained professional on hand to craft your signature balloon animal.

We're throwing a party tomorrow in our retail stores to celebrate #apopofspring! Join us from 6:30-8:30pm to enjoy some delicious snacks (#warbyblue cotton candy included) and have a trained professional craft your signature balloon animal.
A brilliant move by our designers: they digitized the very classic horn then topped it off with a light, airy pink crystal embed. Meet Piper in Digital Horn with Peony.

Join us to celebrate the new season with a super-special event in our retail stores this Thursday from 6:30-8:30pm! We’ll have a trained professional on hand to craft your signature balloon animal. Why? Because balloon animals are fun (they were also part of our Spring 2016 collection). #apopofspring
